In Mercer County, West Virginia, a 21-year-old Rock-area man faces felony charges for allegedly soliciting and sending explicit material to a minor in Raleigh County. No active NWS alerts, major crashes, or other urgent incidents reported in the core area today.[[1]](https://woay.com/virginia-officers-seize-over-1300-ginseng-roots-in-tazewell-county/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/10/mercer-county-man-charged-child-solicitation-case/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Virginia conservation police officers seized 1,352 ginseng roots as evidence after an investigation into illegal harvesting and purchases. The probe began following reports of trespassing to dig wild ginseng in the Bluefield area. One suspect admitted to digging on private property without permission and buying ginseng without a permit; five roots were recovered and returned to the landowner. Six of the seized roots were underage. Officers also responded to two additional trespassing incidents, recovering and returning 42 more roots. Violations include trespassing to dig ginseng, buying without a permit, and unlawful possession. Wild American ginseng is a threatened species in Virginia with strict harvest regulations. [OSINT - NEWS][[1]](https://woay.com/virginia-officers-seize-over-1300-ginseng-roots-in-tazewell-county/)

**Mercer County, WV / Raleigh County, WV:** Trent Addison Nunn, 21, of the Rock area in Mercer County, was charged with one count of distribute or display obscene material to a minor and one count of soliciting a minor via computer. The alleged incidents occurred in Raleigh County in May 2026 via Instagram. Nunn was arrested November 6 and remains held at Southern Regional Jail on a $150,000 surety/cash bond. A preliminary hearing is set for November 16 in Raleigh County Magistrate Court.
